name: Household HQ
tagline: Run the family: meals, school, home and the thoughtful stuff.
rationale: A household is a small operation with no ops person. This bundle is that person: it watches the family calendar and inbox, plans and orders the week's meals, keeps an eye on the kids' schoolwork, drives the home robots, and remembers the thoughtful things before they slip. The admin runs itself so the family time doesn't get eaten by it.

members.name: Tradbot
members.reason: A household chief of staff that watches the family inbox and calendar so school and home items stop slipping.

members.name: Chef
members.reason: Plans the week's meals, turns the plan into a shopping list, and places the grocery order.

members.name: Homework Checker
members.reason: A weekday recap of a kid's missing assignments and grades, with a quick explainer when a score dips.

members.name: Home Robots
members.reason: Runs the mower, the vacuum and the rest of your Matter home robots from a single chat.

members.name: Love ❤️
members.reason: Keeps the thoughtful part of a relationship from slipping: dates, tables and presents, remembered and queued.
